meta.name: The Mothers of Penguins
meta.description: When her seven-year-old son moves to a new school, an MMA fighter realizes that her toughest fight won't be in the octagon, but in parenthood.

videos.title: Something Wrong
videos.overview: After an incident at his school, Kama is forced to move Jaś to a school for kids with special needs.

videos.title: Online
videos.overview: When Ula broadcasts Kama's newfound situation to her followers, it prompts a myriad of unwanted opinions from friends and family.

videos.title: The Challenges
videos.overview: Kama grows frustrated when a field trip reveals flaws in Wonderful Harbor's schooling system, prompting an unlikely alliance.

videos.title: Failure
videos.overview: With a new injury, Kama finds it harder than ever to stay on top of her parental duties. Hela's Birthday party pushes the parents to breaking point.

videos.title: #protest
videos.overview: Tatiana finally has a tough conversation with her husband, while Ula organises a protest on behalf of the students.

videos.title: Knockout
videos.overview: Ula discovers who her anonymous donor is, just as Wonderful Harbor makes a devastating announcement.
